criteria.description: The audit credibly shows two distinct, context-isolated reviewers using the same inputs and rubric in each round, specific blocker discovery, issue-driven repair, fresh re-review after changes, and a final gate that opens only when both reviewers pass within three rounds.

completion_gate.rationale: Every task-specific delivery condition is required. No weighted quality points or partial credit are awarded.
